title: 幼儿园功能区设计术语

intro.visual: 角色扮演区 + 交通骑行区 + 美工涂鸦区
intro.background: 温尚提供室内18项+户外14项区域整体定制。户外功能区包括：大型玩具区、托育玩具区、角色扮演区（Sale Area）、交通骑行区（Cycling Area）、艺术涂鸦区、音乐舞台、沙水区、种养殖区、野战区、低结构体验区、体能区、微体锻区、攀爬墙、收纳区。室内功能教室包括：班级教室、阅读室、美工室、科学室、木工坊、建构室、生活室、自然科探馆等。角色扮演区有具体SKU：厨房操作台092-JS01（110×50×100cm）、美食小屋092-JS05、花店092-JS06、咖啡铺092-JS08。
intro.desc: 掌握温尚室内外功能区完整术语，能和客户讨论空间规划和产品配置。
tasks: 掌握角色扮演区和交通区具体产品
outcomes: 能介绍完整功能区方案

oneLiner.en: A modern kindergarten is not rows of desks — it is 14 outdoor zones and 18 indoor zones, from role play sale areas to cycling tracks, each with dedicated furniture and equipment.
oneLiner.cn: 现代幼儿园不是一排排课桌——而是14个户外区和18个室内区，从角色扮演售卖区到交通骑行道，每个区有专属家具设备。

vocab.ex: Our role play area includes a mini kitchen, gourmet house, flower shop and coffee stall.
vocab.exCn: 我们的角色扮演区包括迷你厨房、美食小屋、花店和咖啡铺。

vocab.ex: The cycling area has traffic signs, a gas station, parking shed and balance bikes.
vocab.exCn: 交通骑行区有交通标志、加油站、停车棚和平衡车。

vocab.ex: The sand and water zone has a water wheel, bridges and a sensory wall.
vocab.exCn: 沙水区有水车、小桥和触摸墙。

vocab.ex: The planting and breeding area lets children grow vegetables and feed small animals.
vocab.exCn: 种养殖区让孩子种菜和喂小动物。

vocab.ex: The art area has a graffiti wall, easels and a chalkboard panel.
vocab.exCn: 美工区有涂鸦墙、画架和黑板面板。

vocab.ex: The music stage includes a drum, cymbals and a percussion wall.
vocab.exCn: 音乐舞台有鼓、钹和打击乐墙。

vocab.ex: The low-structure experience zone uses crates, tires and planks for open-ended play.
vocab.cn: 低结构体验区/低结构材料
vocab.exCn: 低结构体验区用木箱、轮胎和木板做开放式游戏。

vocab.ex: We provide outdoor storage sheds for toys and sports equipment.
vocab.exCn: 我们提供户外玩具和体育器材收纳棚。

mistakes.wrong: We make desks and chairs for classrooms.
mistakes.right: We design complete learning environments — 14 outdoor zones including role play, cycling and sand-water, plus 18 indoor zones from art rooms to science labs.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说做课桌椅。客户要的是完整功能区方案，包括室内外全部区域。

mistakes.wrong: The role play area has some toy kitchens.
mistakes.right: Our role play area includes a kitchen counter (model 092-JS01, 110x50x100cm), a gourmet house (092-JS05), a flower shop (092-JS06) and a coffee stall (092-JS08).
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说有玩具厨房。要说出具体产品型号和尺寸，体现专业度。

basic.en: We can design a complete role play area for you.
basic.cn: 我们可以为您设计完整的角色扮演区。

basic.en: The cycling area includes traffic signs and a parking shed.
basic.cn: 交通骑行区包括交通标志和停车棚。

basic.en: The sand and water zone has a water wheel and bridges.

basic.cn: 我们提供14个户外功能区。

basic.en: The art area has a graffiti wall and easels.
basic.cn: 美工区有涂鸦墙和画架。

basic.en: We can customize the zone layout to your site.
basic.cn: 我们可以根据您的场地定制功能区布局。

advanced.en: Our outdoor package covers 14 functional zones: playground, nursery toys, role play sale area, cycling track, art graffiti, music stage, sand and water, planting and breeding, adventure battle, low-structure, fitness, micro-exercise, climbing wall and storage — each with dedicated SKUs and layout planning.
advanced.cn: 我们的户外套餐覆盖14个功能区：大型玩具、托育玩具、角色扮演售卖区、交通骑行道、艺术涂鸦、音乐舞台、沙水、种养殖、野战、低结构、体能、微体锻、攀爬墙和收纳——每个区有专属SKU和布局规划。

advanced.en: The role play area comes with a kitchen counter (092-JS01), a gourmet house (092-JS05, 200x180x220cm), a flower shop (092-JS06) and a coffee stall (092-JS08) — all in natural Scotch pine with waterborne coating.
advanced.cn: 角色扮演区配备厨房操作台（092-JS01）、美食小屋（092-JS05，200×180×220cm）、花店（092-JS06）和咖啡铺（092-JS08）——全部天然樟子松水性涂料。
advanced.from: We can design a complete role play area for you.

dialogues.title: 客户咨询整园功能区规划

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: We want to outfit the entire outdoor area. Can you do a full zone design?
lines.cn: 我们想配置整个户外区域。你们能做完整的区域设计吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Absolutely. We offer 14 outdoor functional zones: playground, role play sale area, cycling track, art graffiti, music stage, sand and water, planting and breeding, and more. How large is your outdoor area and what is the age range?
lines.cn: 当然。我们提供14个户外功能区：大型玩具、角色扮演售卖区、交通骑行道、艺术涂鸦、音乐舞台、沙水、种养殖等等。您的户外面积多大？年龄段是？

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: About 500 square meters, ages 3 to 6. We especially want a role play area and a cycling track.
lines.cn: 约500平米，3-6岁。我们特别想要角色扮演区和交通骑行道。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Perfect. For the role play area, I recommend our kitchen counter (092-JS01), gourmet house (092-JS05) and coffee stall (092-JS08). For the cycling track, we can do traffic signs, a gas station, parking shed and balance bikes. We will provide a full zone layout with product list within 3 days.
lines.cn: 好的。角色扮演区我推荐厨房操作台（092-JS01）、美食小屋（092-JS05）和咖啡铺（092-JS08）。交通骑行道我们可以做交通标志、加油站、停车棚和平衡车。我们3天内出完整区域布局和产品清单。

fillBlank.q: The ____ play area includes a mini kitchen and gourmet house.
The ____ area has traffic signs and balance bikes.
We offer ____ outdoor functional zones in total.
The sand and ____ zone has a water wheel and bridges.

scenario.q: A client has a 500 sqm outdoor area for ages 3-6 and wants a role play zone plus a cycling track. What do you propose?
scenario.modelAnswer: For 500 sqm, I propose a role play sale area with a kitchen counter (092-JS01), gourmet house (092-JS05, 200x180x220cm), flower shop (092-JS06) and coffee stall (092-JS08), all in natural Scotch pine. For the cycling track, we include traffic signs, a gas station prop, a parking shed and balance bike storage. We can also add a sand-water zone and art graffiti wall if space allows. We will deliver a full zone layout with product list and pricing within 3 working days.
scenario.cn: 500平米我建议：角色扮演售卖区配厨房操作台（092-JS01）、美食小屋（092-JS05，200×180×220cm）、花店（092-JS06）和咖啡铺（092-JS08），全部天然樟子松。交通骑行道配交通标志、加油站道具、停车棚和平衡车收纳。空间允许的话还可以加沙水区和美工涂鸦墙。我们3个工作日内出完整区域布局和产品报价清单。

checklist: 我能说出14个户外功能区名称
我能说出至少6个室内功能教室
我能介绍角色扮演区的4个具体产品型号
我能描述交通骑行区的配置
我能根据面积推荐功能区组合
我能承诺3天出布局和产品清单

culture.title: 欧美幼儿园的功能区文化
culture.content: 欧美幼儿园强调孩子自主选择，功能区设计要体现：低矮家具孩子自取、灵活隔断、开放性材料loose parts、每个区有边界但不封闭。和欧美客户沟通时多用child-led、open-ended、self-access这些词，他们一听就知道你懂行。温尚的14+18区域体系是整园项目的敲门砖——客户说要做幼儿园，你直接报出完整区域清单，比只说做桌椅的同行专业10倍。

aiPractice.situation: 英国客户Sarah要为新幼儿园做整户外功能区规划。

rounds.ai: We want to outfit the entire outdoor area. Can you design all the zones?
rounds.cn: 我们想配置整个户外区域。你们能设计所有区域吗？
rounds.hint: 介绍14个户外功能区，问面积和年龄段。

rounds.ai: About 500 square meters, ages 3 to 6. We especially want a role play area.
rounds.cn: 约500平米，3-6岁。我们特别想要角色扮演区。
rounds.hint: 推荐厨房操作台092-JS01、美食小屋092-JS05、咖啡铺092-JS08，樟子松水性涂料。

rounds.ai: How soon can you send the layout and product list?
rounds.cn: 多久能出布局和产品清单？
rounds.hint: 3个工作日出布局+产品清单+报价。
